name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering (Software)
definition: A software renderer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that renders a list of 3D Gaussians to a 2D buffer by projecting them to screen space, computing a 2D covariance matrix, and rasterizing the resulting ellipses.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a novel view synthesis method that represents scenes as 3D Gaussian ellipsoids, enabling fast, high-quality real-time rendering via a differentiable, tile-based software rasterizer.
